patch_description: This redesign separates the filter into three stages: robust multi-horizon measurement extraction, agreement-driven alpha-beta state tracking, and reversal-gated output stabilization. Short and long endpoint regressions produce responsive and stable observations, while a lightweight recent slope controls tracker gains internally. A persistent trend state suppresses noise-driven direction flips without excessively delaying confirmed reversals. The public functions, arguments, output alignment, validation behavior, and return formats are preserved.
